title: Design: Pays for counter sits beside Contacts and Assets with a blue number
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A (it pays for others) and customer B, with customer A saved as customer B's Bill Invoices To in Edit Customer, so one customer is the other's saved payer.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-16-after-pays-for-counter.png, bt-p1-15-before-customer-page.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The counters row shows three counters: Contacts, Assets and "Pays for".
  • The Pays for number reads 1 and is blue; the other two numbers are black.
  • The three counters fit on one row inside the card.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R7: “When at least one customer has this customer as its default, the card shows a "Pays for" counter beside Contacts and Assets, with the count.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To", pictures "Pays for counter" (This build), "Customer page" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
